mapper.select: select * from tj_sic where year=#{year} and month=#{month} and day=#{day} and var_model="SIC_Ice-BCNet"

select * from tj_sic where year=#{year} and var_model in ( 'MITgcm(with DA)withBC_RMSE', 'withDA_withoutBC_RMSE', 'withoutDA_withBC_RMSE', 'withoutDA_withoutBC' ) order by case var_model when 'withoutDA_withoutBC' then 1 when 'withoutDA_withBC_RMSE' then 2 when 'withDA_withoutBC_RMSE' then 3 when 'MITgcm(with DA)withBC_RMSE' then 4 else 99 end, cast(month as decimal), cast(day as decimal), id

SELECT year, month FROM tj_sic GROUP BY year, month HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN var_model IN ( CONCAT(year, '_BACC'), CONCAT(year, '_per_BACC'), CONCAT(year, '_RMSE'), CONCAT(year, '_per_RMSE') ) THEN var_model END) = 4 ORDER BY CAST(year AS DECIMAL), CAST(month AS DECIMAL)

SELECT year FROM tj_sic WHERE var_model IN ( 'MITgcm(with DA)withBC_RMSE', 'withDA_withoutBC_RMSE', 'withoutDA_withBC_RMSE', 'withoutDA_withoutBC' ) GROUP BY year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT var_model) = 4 ORDER BY CAST(year AS DECIMAL)
SELECT DISTINCT year FROM tj_sic ORDER BY year DESC
SELECT year, month, day FROM tj_sic ORDER BY CAST(year AS DECIMAL) DESC, CAST(month AS DECIMAL) DESC, CAST(day AS DECIMAL) DESC LIMIT 1
